verdict.rationale: Front-door reachability is a fair question for a government registry's public guidance pages, so the axis applies. Direct probes with a standard identified user agent got HTTP 403 at robots.txt on both mca.gov.in and the National Single Window host. That is a bot wall in front of the public reading surface, the opposite of what the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
